item.title: Fisheries body stands over its Weir salmon numbers data
item.description: Inland Fisheries Ireland (IFI) has insisted it stands over the data it collected about wild Atlantic salmon numbers passing through Galway Weir. item.description: Developers have broken ground on a €50 million primary care ‘superhub’ on the Seamus Quirke Road.
